cases.sentence: Спайка, сделанная Анной, оказалась непрочна, и ___ надломилось опять в том же месте.
cases.explain: «семейное согласие» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Dolly could not help sighing. Her dearest friend, her sister, was going away. And her life was not a cheerful one. Her relations with Stepan Arkadyevitch after their reconciliation had become humiliating. The union Anna had cemented turned out to be of no solid character, and family harmony was breaking down again at the same point. There had been nothing definite, but Stepan Arkadyevitch was hardly ever at home; money, too, was hardly ever forthcoming, and Dolly was continually tortured by suspicions of infidelity, which she tried to dismiss, dreading the agonies of jealousy she had been through already. The first onslaught of jealousy, once lived through, could never come back again, and even the discovery of infidelities could never now affect her as it had the first time. Such a discovery now would only mean breaking up family habits, and she let herself be deceived, despising him and still more herself, for the weakness. Besides this, the care of her large family was a constant worry to her: first, the nursing of her young baby did not go well, then the nurse had gone away, now one of the children had fallen ill.

cases.sentence: Первый взрыв ревности, раз пережитый, уже не мог возвратиться, и даже открытие неверности не могло бы уже так подействовать на нее, как в ___.
cases.explain: «первый раз» — after the preposition «в», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.

cases.sentence: ___ после отъезда доктора тоже вышел из своего кабинета и, подставив свою щеку Долли и поговорив с ней, обратился к жене:
cases.explain: «Старый князь» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The old prince too had come in from his study after the doctor’s departure, and after presenting his cheek to Dolly, and saying a few words to her, he turned to his wife:

cases.sentence: ___ встал и погладил рукой волосы Кити.
cases.explain: «Старый князь» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The old prince got up and stroked Kitty’s hair. She lifted her head and looked at him with a forced smile. It always seemed to her that he understood her better than anyone in the family, though he did not say much about her. Being the youngest, she was her father’s favorite, and she fancied that his love gave him insight. When now her glance met his blue kindly eyes looking intently at her, it seemed to her that he saw right through her, and understood all that was not good that was passing within her. Reddening, she stretched out towards him expecting a kiss, but he only patted her hair and said:

cases.sentence: До настоящей дочери и не доберешься, а ласкаешь волосы ___.
cases.explain: «дохлых баб» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: “These stupid chignons! There’s no getting at the real daughter. One simply strokes the bristles of dead women. Well, Dolinka,” he turned to his elder daughter, “what’s your young buck about, hey?”

cases.sentence: Ну что, Долинька, – обратился он к ___, – твой козырь что поделывает?
cases.explain: «старшей дочери» — after the preposition «к», the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: “These stupid chignons! There’s no getting at the real daughter. One simply strokes the bristles of dead women. Well, Dolinka,” he turned to his elder daughter, “what’s your young buck about, hey?”

cases.sentence: Бог милостив… благодарствуй… – говорил он, уже сам не зная, что говорит, и отвечая на ___ княгини, который он почувствовал на своей руке.
cases.explain: «мокрый поцелуй» — after the preposition «на», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: “There, that’s enough, that’s enough! You’re wretched too, I know. It can’t be helped. There’s no great harm done. God is merciful … thanks. …” he said, not knowing what he was saying, as he responded to the tearful kiss of the princess that he felt on his hand. And the prince went out of the room.

cases.sentence: – Я вам давно хотела сказать, maman: – вы знаете ли, что Левин хотел сделать предложение Кити, когда он был здесь в ___?
cases.explain: «последний раз» — after the preposition «в», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: “I’d been meaning to tell you something for a long while, mamma: did you know that Levin meant to make Kitty an offer when he was here the last time? He told Stiva so.”
